Pinkie Flamingo Welcomes You to Sea Shed at The Bungalos!
King / King / 2 Twins / 3.5 Baths

That's What Sea Shed! Coastal cottage charm meets the magic of Sandestin in this cozy bungalow on a shady corner lot. With a 6-seater golf cart included in your stay, your vacation adventure will begin here and take you...who knows where? Visitors flock to this popular resort community to indulge in the fabulous amenities to be found here such as the heated community pool with plenty of space for sun-bathing and swimming. Check out the neighborhood putting green as you warm up to enjoy one of the numerous nearby golf courses. It's just 8 min to the beaches and a fun ride all the way! In fact All Sandestin activities are easily accessed via walking, bicycle, (rentals available at the marina) or by the golf cart included with your rental.

As a vacation destination, the Sea Shed at The Bunglaos could not be more ideal. Local dining and shopping is just minutes away and tourist attractions can be found at every turn. Visitors love Baytowne Wharf, Silver Sands outlet Mall and The Grand Boulevard. Located in the heart of The Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. the resort offers guests access to an unparalleled combination of amenities, activities, convenience, and beach access not found anywhere else on the panhandle.

All Sandestin activities are easily accessed via walking, bicycle, (rentals available at the marina) or by the golf cart included with your rental.

Let's go inside the cottage for a little walk-about. You will notice the screened-in front porch invites you to sit and relax a bit but there's so much more to see inside. Newly decorated, furnished and painted in soft hues of watercolor blues and whites, this cottage serves up classic coastal style at every turn. The fully equipped granite and stainless kitchen has everything you need to prepare a fabulous family feast. Dine at the table set for 6 or at the breakfast counter. Extra table leaves may be added to accommodate up to 8 at the table. The open concept first floor has multiple spots to sit and gather while enjoying the wall-mounted flat screen TV or engaging in conversations with family and friends. This is a 2-story floor plan with 2 king bedrooms and it is perfect for 2 couples and the twin singles in the third bedroom work great for kids. No one is crowded with 3 ½ bathrooms to choose from. We all cannot wait to find out what “Sea Shed”!

description: Located in Miramar Beach, this vacation home is near the beach. Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park is a popular attraction and the area's natural beauty can be seen at Miramar Beach and Santa Rosa Beach. Blast Arcade and Laser Maze and Sirens at the Beach are also worth visiting. Scuba diving, snorkeling, and parasailing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
